scope: Prevent adapter conversion from silently dropping retained action-path and rendering OBJECTS callbacks.

implementation.behavior: DXF adapter preflight fails with a family-specific diagnostic when any corresponding retained callback list is nonempty. Capture failures keep their existing more-specific diagnostics.
implementation.destination: Output is refused before publication; the focused control verifies an existing destination remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
implementation.qualification: This is a loss-prevention gate. It does not implement output or establish source spans, producer fields, ownership/reference closure, readback, or native semantics.

validation.inputs: Locally authored in-memory callback values; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
validation.result: PASS: all four focused CTest selectors passed; existing destinations were preserved for successfully captured but unqualified records.
